text: Cookie Policy
Last updated: 27 September 2026
This Cookie Policy explains how Elevate Core uses cookies and similar technologies on https://el-core.eu, what they are used for, and how you can control your preferences.
This Cookie Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy, which explains how we process personal data more generally.
1. Who we are
The website https://el-core.eu is operated by:

For the purposes of applicable data protection laws, ElevateCoreOutsourcing is the controller of personal data processed through our website unless otherwise stated.
2. What are cookies?
Cookies are small text files that a website may store on your computer, smartphone, tablet or other device when you visit it.
They can help a website:
operate correctly;
remember your choices and preferences;
understand how visitors use the website;
improve performance and user experience;
measure the effectiveness of content or campaigns;
provide certain third-party functionality.
Cookies may be:
Session cookies — deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies — remain on your device for a defined period or until you delete them.
First-party cookies — placed by Elevate Core.
Third-party cookies — placed by another provider whose technology or service is used on our website.
3. Similar technologies
In addition to cookies, websites may use similar technologies such as:
local storage;
pixels;
tags;
scripts;
tracking technologies;
embedded third-party technologies.
For simplicity, we refer to these technologies collectively as “cookies” in this Policy where appropriate.
4. What types of cookies may we use?
The exact cookies currently used on the website, including their provider, purpose and duration, are available through our Cookie Settings.
Depending on the website functionality and your choices, the following categories may be used.
Strictly necessary cookies
These cookies are required for the website to operate or to provide a service you have specifically requested.
They may be used, for example, to:
maintain website security;
manage technical website functionality;
store your cookie consent preferences;
ensure pages and forms work correctly;
prevent abuse or technical errors.
Strictly necessary cookies cannot normally be disabled through our Cookie Settings because the website may not function correctly without them.
Where permitted by applicable law, these cookies do not require your consent.
Functional or preference cookies
These cookies allow the website to remember choices you make and provide additional functionality or a more personalised experience.
They may, for example, remember:
language preferences;
interface preferences;
certain website settings.
Where legally required, these cookies are activated only after you give consent.
Analytics cookies
Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
They may provide information such as:
which pages are visited;
how visitors navigate through the website;
how long visitors spend on certain pages;
general website performance;
technical errors or usability issues.
We use analytics cookies only where the required consent has been provided.
Marketing cookies
Marketing cookies may be used to understand the effectiveness of campaigns, measure conversions or support advertising and remarketing activities.
They may also allow third-party platforms to recognise a browser or device across different websites.
Marketing cookies are not activated unless you have provided the required consent.
5. Which cookies are currently used?
Because website technologies may change, the most accurate and up-to-date list of cookies is provided through Cookie Settings on our website.
For each cookie or similar technology, we aim to provide information including:
cookie name;
provider;
category;
purpose;
whether it is a first-party or third-party cookie;
duration or expiry period.
We periodically review this information to ensure that it reflects the technologies actually used on the website.
6. Your consent
When you first visit our website, you may be shown a cookie banner allowing you to make a choice about non-essential cookies.
Where consent is legally required, non-essential cookies are not activated before you make your choice.
You may be able to:
Accept all optional cookies;
Reject all optional cookies;
open Cookie Settings and select individual categories.
Rejecting optional cookies will not prevent you from accessing the main content of our website, although certain optional functions may work differently or may not be available.
7. Changing or withdrawing your consent
You can change or withdraw your cookie consent at any time through Cookie Settings available on our website.
Withdrawing consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before consent was withdrawn.
We may ask you to renew your cookie preferences from time to time, particularly where:
your previous consent expires;
the technologies we use materially change;
the purposes for which cookies are used change;
applicable legal requirements change.
8. Legal basis
For cookies that are strictly necessary to provide the website or a service explicitly requested by you, consent may not be required under applicable electronic communications rules.
Where personal data are processed through such technologies, the applicable legal basis under the GDPR will depend on the specific purpose of the processing.
For analytics, marketing, personalisation and other non-essential cookies requiring consent, we rely on your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR.
You may withdraw that consent at any time.
9. Third-party services
Our website may use or link to services provided by third parties, including communication, scheduling, analytics, social media or other technology providers.
Examples may include services such as:
LinkedIn;
WhatsApp;
Telegram;
scheduling or booking platforms;
analytics providers;
hosting and website infrastructure providers.

A simple external link does not necessarily mean that the third party places cookies on our website. However, embedded content, integrations or third-party scripts may involve the use of cookies or similar technologies.
Where third-party cookies are used, those providers may process information according to their own privacy and cookie policies.
The current third-party technologies operating through the website are identified, where applicable, in Cookie Settings.
10. International data transfers
Some technology providers may process information outside the European Economic Area (“EEA”).
Where personal data collected through cookies are transferred outside the EEA, we apply the safeguards required under applicable data protection law.
Depending on the circumstances, these may include:
an adequacy decision of the European Commission;
Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission;
other recognised safeguards under Chapter V GDPR.
More information about international transfers is available in our Privacy Policy.
11. Managing cookies through your browser
Most browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings.
Depending on your browser, you may be able to:
view stored cookies;
delete individual or all cookies;
block cookies from specific websites;
block third-party cookies;
prevent cookies from being stored.
Please note that blocking strictly necessary cookies through your browser may affect the functionality of the website.
Browser settings operate independently from the consent choices available through our website.
12. Personal data and your rights
Some cookies and similar technologies may involve the processing of personal data, such as:
IP address;
browser or device identifiers;
website activity;
technical information;
consent preferences.
Where the GDPR applies, you may have rights relating to this personal data, including rights of access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and withdrawal of consent.
For more information about how we process personal data and how to exercise your rights, please see our Privacy Policy.
13. Updates to this Cookie Policy
We may update this Cookie Policy when:
the technologies used on our website change;
we introduce or remove services;
our processing activities change;
legal or regulatory requirements change.
The latest version will always be available on this page together with the date of the most recent update.
The current list of individual cookies may be updated separately through Cookie Settings when website technologies change.
14. Contact us
If you have questions about this Cookie Policy or our use of cookies, contact:
